title: [Đề 12] Bộ Đề Thực Chiến B1 Số 08 — Chuẩn Đầu Ra ULIS (The Black Mamba)
description: Đề luyện thi thực chiến VNU Test Bậc 3 chuẩn hóa theo khung năng lực ngoại ngữ Bậc 3 (CEFR B1). Bài đọc thực tế: The Black Mamba (Part 2), Nene Valley Railway (Part 3), Headteacher Mary Collins: Healthy School Days (Part 4).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) that matches the meaning of each sign, message, or notice.

questions.prompt:
Joe,
I phoned the ticket office and booked tickets for the play on Saturday. Could you get them on your way home from work tonight?

options.text: Joe will get the tickets at the ticket office on Saturday.
Joe can book tickets for the play on Saturday.
Joe can get the tickets before the play on Saturday.

questions.explanationVi: Người viết nhắn cho Joe: 'I phoned the ticket office and booked tickets for the play on Saturday. Could you get them on your way home from work tonight?' (Mình đã gọi phòng vé và đặt vé xem kịch vào thứ Bảy rồi. Bạn có thể ghé lấy vé trên đường đi làm về tối nay được không?). Vì vé đã được đặt trước và Joe có thể lấy vào tối nay, tức là lấy vé trước buổi diễn ngày thứ Bảy ('get the tickets before the play on Saturday'). Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: Staff must have their identity cards with them at all times in the building.

options.text: Staff mustn't go into the building without their cards.
Staff don't need their cards when they are in the building.
Staff need to have their cards in some places in the building.

questions.explanationVi: Quy định ghi rõ: 'Staff must have their identity cards with them at all times in the building.' (Nhân viên bắt buộc phải mang theo thẻ định danh bên mình mọi lúc khi ở trong tòa nhà). Điều này đồng nghĩa với việc nhân viên không được phép vào tòa nhà nếu không mang theo thẻ ('mustn't go into the building without their cards'). Phương án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: thẻ căn cước / thẻ nhân viên định danh

questions.prompt: Wednesday's dance class will take place in Studio 5 this week, not 2.

options.text: The time of the dance class has changed.
The place of the dance class has changed.
The day of the dance class has changed.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo viết: 'Wednesday's dance class will take place in Studio 5 this week, not 2.' (Lớp học nhảy ngày thứ Tư tuần này sẽ diễn ra tại Phòng tập số 5, thay vì Phòng số 2). Như vậy địa điểm học ('the place of the dance class') đã thay đổi. Phương án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: phòng tập nghệ thuật / khiêu vũ

questions.prompt:
I'll be late home today. Please prepare dinner. The chicken and potatoes are in the fridge. They must go in the oven for 40 minutes.

What does the person need to do?

options.text: put the food in the oven after 40 minutes
choose what food from the fridge to eat for dinner
cook the evening meal in the oven

questions.explanationVi: Lời nhắn viết: 'Please prepare dinner. The chicken and potatoes are in the fridge. They must go in the oven for 40 minutes.' (Làm ơn chuẩn bị bữa tối giúp nhé. Thịt gà và khoai tây để trong tủ lạnh. Chúng cần được nướng trong lò 40 phút). Như vậy người nhận tin nhắn cần nấu bữa ăn tối bằng lò nướng ('cook the evening meal in the oven'). Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt:
Subject: Office kitchen
Please label all food boxes in the fridge with your name.
Don't leave anything in the fridge for more than a week.

options.text: People can't leave their food in the fridge for a long time.
People can keep food in the fridge for more than a week.
People must write what is in their food boxes.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo khu bếp văn phòng yêu cầu: 'Don't leave anything in the fridge for more than a week.' (Không để bất cứ thứ gì trong tủ lạnh quá một tuần). Điều này đồng nghĩa mọi người không được để thức ăn trong tủ lạnh suốt thời gian dài ('can't leave their food in the fridge for a long time'). Phương án C sai vì nhân viên phải ghi tên mình ('with your name') chứ không phải ghi tên món ăn bên trong. Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
Is your appointment more than 15 minutes late?
Please inform staff at the desk.

options.text: You must wait for 15 minutes to get an appointment.
You shouldn't wait for more than 15 minutes.
You should ask the staff for a 15-minute appointment.

questions.explanationVi: Biển thông báo tại phòng khám/văn phòng ghi: 'Is your appointment more than 15 minutes late? Please inform staff at the desk.' (Cuộc hẹn của bạn đã bị trễ quá 15 phút? Vui lòng báo cho nhân viên tại quầy). Điều này có nghĩa là bạn không nên ngồi đợi quá 15 phút quá giờ hẹn mà hãy báo ngay cho nhân viên ('You shouldn't wait for more than 15 minutes'). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt:
NOTICE
DO NOT LEAN BIKES AGAINST GLASS WINDOW

options.text: Do not park your bike on the pavement or street overnight.
Glass window can be very dangerous when broken.
Do not leave your bicycle touching the window.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo ghi: 'DO NOT LEAN BIKES AGAINST GLASS WINDOW' (Không dựng/tựa xe đạp vào cửa sổ kính). Cụm 'lean bikes against glass window' đồng nghĩa với việc để xe đạp chạm/tựa vào cửa sổ ('leave your bicycle touching the window'). Phương án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Cloze Test
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each blank from 8 to 15.

passage.title: The Black Mamba
passage.text:
A bite from the Black Mamba is (8) ________ 'the kiss of death' in South Africa and it is (9) ________ a very dangerous snake. The venom can kill a person within 30 minutes to a few hours (10) ________ medical help. Anyone who (11) ________ out more about this reptile will be amazed by its speed.

It is one of the world's fastest snakes as well and can travel at up to 16 kilometres an hour, though it uses this speed to (12) ________ danger rather than to attack. In fact, the Black Mamba is a rather (13) ________ creature and will avoid humans whenever it (14) ________ people in the wild. It can measure anywhere between two and four metres long and, (15) ________ on the area where it lives, can be a different colour, from brown to green to grey. It gets its name from the inside of its mouth, which is ink black.

questions.prompt: A bite from the Black Mamba is (8) ________ 'the kiss of death' in South Africa...

options.text: said
made
called

questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc bị động 'be called + tên gọi' ('is called the kiss of death': được gọi là nụ hôn tử thần). 'said' phải đi với 'to be', 'made' là được làm ra. Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: ...and it is (9) ________ a very dangerous snake.

options.text: certainly
exactly
just

questions.explanationVi: Trạng từ 'certainly' mang nghĩa 'chắc chắn, thực sự là' dùng để nhấn mạnh mức độ nguy hiểm của loài rắn ('it is certainly a very dangerous snake'). 'exactly' là chính xác, 'just' là chỉ mới/chỉ là. Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: The venom can kill a person within 30 minutes to a few hours (10) ________ medical help.

options.text: outside
besides
without

questions.explanationVi: Giới từ 'without' mang nghĩa 'nếu không có' ('without medical help': nếu không có sự cứu chữa y tế). 'outside' là bên ngoài, 'besides' là bên cạnh đó. Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: sự trợ giúp/cứu chữa y tế

questions.prompt: Anyone who (11) ________ out more about this reptile will be amazed by its speed.

options.text: looks
finds
learns

questions.explanationVi: Cụm động từ (phrasal verb) 'find out' có nghĩa là tìm hiểu, khám phá ra thông tin ('Anyone who finds out more about this reptile'). 'look out' là coi chừng, 'learn' không đi với 'out'. Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt: ...though it uses this speed to (12) ________ danger rather than to attack.

options.text: break
escape
lose

questions.explanationVi: Cụm từ 'escape danger' có nghĩa là thoát khỏi nguy hiểm ('it uses this speed to escape danger rather than to attack': nó dùng tốc độ này để trốn chạy nguy hiểm hơn là để tấn công). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt: In fact, the Black Mamba is a rather (13) ________ creature and will avoid humans...

options.text: shy
brave
afraid

questions.explanationVi: Tính từ 'shy' khi miêu tả động vật hoang dã có nghĩa là nhút nhát, hay lẩn tránh con người ('a rather shy creature and will avoid humans'). Tính từ 'afraid' không đứng trước danh từ ('a afraid creature' là sai ngữ pháp). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: ...and will avoid humans whenever it (14) ________ people in the wild.

options.text: knows
meets
speaks

questions.explanationVi: Động từ 'meet' mang nghĩa bắt gặp, chạm trán ('whenever it meets people in the wild': bất cứ khi nào nó bắt gặp con người ngoài tự nhiên). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt: It can measure anywhere between two and four metres long and, (15) ________ on the area where it lives, can be a different colour...

options.text: relying
choosing
depending

questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'depending on something' có nghĩa là tùy thuộc vào điều gì ('depending on the area where it lives': tùy thuộc vào khu vực nơi nó sinh sống). 'relying on' là dựa dẫm/tin cậy vào, 'choosing' không đi với giới từ 'on'. Phương án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 3: True / False
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and decide whether the statements from 16 to 20 are True or False. Choose A for True and B for False.

passage.title: Nene Valley Railway
passage.text:
About the Railway
The twelve-kilometre-long Nene Valley Railway passes through the lovely Nene Park, from an Eastern terminus at Peterborough to the Railway's headquarters at Wansford (next to the A1 main road). A two-kilometre extension of the Railway takes passengers through Wansford Tunnel to the quiet beauty of Yarwell, the present Western end of the line.
Fares: adult £10.00, child £5.00, Family Fare (up to 2 adults and 3 children) £25.00. Special prices may apply on public holidays.

Nene Park
With golf courses and a large Caravan Club site, why not make it a complete day out for the family by visiting Nene Park? There are thousands of hectares of public parkland with boating lakes, picnic areas and a nature reserve, as well as a miniature railway.

Wansford
The buffet, bar and souvenir shop, however, are only open on days when the train is running. A site entrance fee of £2.00 for adults and £1.00 for children is charged at Wansford. Wansford Station is the home of a unique collection of historic trains from many parts of Europe. This includes such famous types as the elegant De Glen Compound locomotive from France, and the German Class 52 Kriegslok (the largest working steam engine in Britain) as well as '92 Squadron' and 'Mayflower' which were built in Britain. You can see these engines all year round whether or not the Nene Valley Railway is running.

A Famous Railway
Nene Valley Railway is a favourite with film makers, due in particular to its ability to take on the appearance of a railway in any part of Europe. Octopussy, in the series of James Bond movies, is a good example of what can be done. Come and see where it was filmed.

Services for Schools
The Railway runs special timetable services from May to July to allow school groups to visit the railway and for teachers to set projects. The work can be done while pupils are here or in the classroom. A special educational pack is available, price £1.50 plus postage. At other times of the year, school parties can hire the train ('Teddy Bear') with up to 3 carriages to travel along the Railway on non-service days. One month's prior booking is requested. There are special low fares for groups of 60 or more pupils.

Private Hire of Trains
The Railway is a popular place for special family occasions or a company visit. It can provide the setting for a most interesting afternoon or evening out. Special programmes can be arranged to meet your wishes to include buffet, bar, entertainment, discos, etc. For further information please contact the General Manager at Wansford Station.

questions.prompt: One adult and three children can buy a Family Fare.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationVi: Trong phần 'About the Railway': 'Family Fare (up to 2 adults and 3 children) £25.00' (Vé gia đình áp dụng cho tối đa 2 người lớn và 3 trẻ em). Một người lớn và 3 trẻ em nằm trong giới hạn 'up to 2 adults and 3 children' nên hoàn toàn có thể mua vé Family Fare. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True).

questions.prompt: The biggest steam engine at Wansford is French.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 'Wansford' nêu rõ: 'This includes such famous types as the elegant De Glen Compound locomotive from France, and the German Class 52 Kriegslok (the largest working steam engine in Britain)...' Đầu máy hơi nước lớn nhất đang hoạt động là chiếc Class 52 Kriegslok của Đức ('German'), không phải của Pháp ('French'). Nhận định là SAI (False).

questions.prompt: A site entrance fee is charged to visit Wansford Station.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 'Wansford' ghi rõ: 'A site entrance fee of £2.00 for adults and £1.00 for children is charged at Wansford.' (Phí vào cổng £2.00 cho người lớn và £1.00 cho trẻ em được thu tại ga Wansford). Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True).

questions.prompt: Groups of school children can only visit the railway in May or June.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 'Services for Schools' viết: 'The Railway runs special timetable services from May to July to allow school groups to visit the railway... At other times of the year, school parties can hire the train ('Teddy Bear')...' Như vậy các đoàn học sinh có thể tham quan từ tháng 5 đến tháng 7 và thuê tàu vào các thời điểm khác trong năm, chứ không chỉ giới hạn ở tháng 5 hoặc tháng 6. Nhận định là SAI (False).

questions.prompt: You can book a train for a private party.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 'Private Hire of Trains' nêu rõ: 'The Railway is a popular place for special family occasions or a company visit... Special programmes can be arranged to meet your wishes to include buffet, bar, entertainment, discos, etc.' Như vậy hoàn toàn có thể đặt thuê tàu cho một bữa tiệc riêng. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True).

tasks.title: Part 4: Reading Comprehension
tasks.instructions: Read the following passage and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question from 21 to 25.

passage.title: Headteacher Mary Collins: Healthy School Days
passage.text:
Since I took up my role of Head at Franley Junior School I have been keen to educate our children on the importance of developing healthy habits. I started by working with our restaurant manager to come up with tasty new menus that contain lots of healthy ingredients. We change the menu Monday to Friday to encourage the children to try different things and keep unhealthy fried food to a minimum. The children have enjoyed the meals and eat a wide range of fruit and vegetables.

We've also rented an area of land near the school for a vegetable garden and made gardening a part of the school curriculum. Children now prepare the ground for planting, plant the seeds and watch as these turn into healthy fruit and vegetable plants. We're planning to create a child-friendly kitchen so our pupils can discover the pleasure of cooking. I believe all this gives the children an understanding of where our food comes from and very important skills that will stay with them for life.

To support this healthy-eating campaign, we have also made changes to the amount of physical exercise we get our children to do during the day. We start every morning before classes with a 'wake and shake' session in the playground when children get the chance to burn off energy with fun exercise routines. We also have different play times during the day so the playground isn't crowded, which means the children can run around safely. To support this we have also invested in sports equipment such as tennis, football and gym equipment to encourage the youngsters to take up sports.

But it's not just the children who are developing a healthy lifestyle. Several of our teachers have signed up for the Franley Fun Run this summer for the first time and have started a training programme in order to get fit. Many of our pupils have joined them and will be taking part in the run as well. I'm sure that seeing their teachers beside them will inspire them to finish. We have even had several parents show an interest in doing the event as well, so this is something we're all really looking forward to.

questions.prompt: Since Mary joined the school

options.text: fried food is no longer on the menu.
the school has employed a new restaurant manager.
the menu changes daily.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'We change the menu Monday to Friday to encourage the children to try different things and keep unhealthy fried food to a minimum.' (Nhà trường thay đổi thực đơn mỗi ngày từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu = 'the menu changes daily'). Đồ chiên rán chỉ được hạn chế ở mức tối thiểu chứ không phải bị loại bỏ hoàn toàn (nên A sai). Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: nghĩ ra, đề xuất (ý tưởng, thực đơn)

questions.prompt: What does Mary say about gardening?

options.text: It is part of a course of study.
The children are producing food for the school kitchen.
The children are learning to cook the food they grow.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'We've also rented an area of land near the school for a vegetable garden and made gardening a part of the school curriculum.' ('school curriculum' = chương trình học chính khóa của trường = 'a course of study'). Phương án C sai vì căn bếp thân thiện với trẻ em mới đang được lên kế hoạch ('We're planning to create a child-friendly kitchen'). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: Play times

options.text: only take place at the start of the day.
result in the playground getting crowded.
are timed to prevent accidents.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: 'We also have different play times during the day so the playground isn't crowded, which means the children can run around safely.' (Giờ ra chơi được bố trí vào các khung giờ khác nhau trong ngày để sân trường không bị quá đông, giúp học sinh chạy nhảy an toàn = 'timed to prevent accidents'). Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: What does Mary say about the teachers?

options.text: They are all doing the fun run.
They are training with the children.
They have done the fun run before.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 4 viết: 'Several of our teachers have signed up for the Franley Fun Run this summer for the first time and have started a training programme in order to get fit. Many of our pupils have joined them and will be taking part in the run as well.' Như vậy các giáo viên đang tập luyện cùng các em học sinh ('training with the children'). Phương án A sai vì chỉ 'Several of our teachers' (một số giáo viên), C sai vì đây là lần đầu tiên họ tham gia ('for the first time'). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt: What would be a good introduction to this article?

options.text: Franley's new Head Mary Collins explains how she set about getting fit with the children.
Read how Mary Collins, the new school Head, reacted when she was ordered to improve the quality of food on the school menu.
Mary Collins explains how the first aim she set herself in her new job was to create a focus on healthy living.

questions.explanationVi: Ngay câu mở đầu bài viết, hiệu trưởng Mary Collins khẳng định: 'Since I took up my role of Head at Franley Junior School I have been keen to educate our children on the importance of developing healthy habits.' Toàn bài xoay quanh mục tiêu trọng tâm mà bà đặt ra khi nhận chức là xây dựng lối sống lành mạnh toàn diện (ăn uống, trồng rau, vận động) tại trường. Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: đảm nhận một vai trò/chức vụ

tasks.title: Part 1: Short Recordings
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to one short recording TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
[Recording 1 - Where are the woman's glasses?]:
Woman: I can never find my glasses!
Man: Where did you have them last?
Woman: I either had them when I was working, or I left them in the lounge when I was watching television.
Man: They're not in either of those places, you know – you're wearing them!

[Recording 2 - What damage was done to the car?]:
Woman: I'm really annoyed. Someone's damaged my car again.
Man: Don't tell me someone's scratched the paint again!
Woman: No, not scratches this time. Someone's put paint all over the side.

[Recording 3 - What did she bring?]:
Man: Did you remember to bring some toothpaste?
Woman: I think so. Wait a minute, I'll look … soap, towel, toothbrush. Er … no, sorry, I forgot.

[Recording 4 - What did Sally buy?]:
Woman: I see you've been shopping, Sally. What have you got in the bag?
Sally: Well, I went into town to buy a new skirt, but I've come back with a T-shirt and a pair of jeans.
Woman: I thought you wanted some new shoes too.
Sally: Yes, I did. But I couldn't find any I liked.

[Recording 5 - Where are the man and his grandma?]:
Man: Hello, Grandma, can I carry your case?
Grandma: Oh, that's nice of you. Thank you for coming to meet me. Travelling always makes me so nervous!
Man: Don't worry, we'll be in the car soon, and it won't take long to get home.
Grandma: Good, I'll be glad to get away from this noisy station.

[Recording 6 - What would John like to be?]:
Teacher: What do you want to be when you leave school, John? You always wanted to be a professional footballer, didn't you?
Boy: Well, I did. I thought about being a doctor, too, but I don't think I could pass all the exams.
Teacher: What about being an engineer like your brother?
Boy: It's a nice idea – but I think I'd like to do what my dad does. He teaches maths.

[Recording 7 - Which pianist are the two people talking about?]:
Woman: I thought the most interesting pianist in the whole competition was Gavin Willow.
Man: Was he the tall one with long hair?
Woman: Well he was tall, but he had short, dark hair and a beard.
Man: Ah, yes, I know.

questions.prompt: Where are the woman's glasses?

options.text: She is wearing them on her head.
On her desk where she was working.
On the table by the television in the lounge.

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ đoán mình để quên kính ở chỗ làm việc hoặc trong phòng khách cạnh TV, nhưng người đàn ông chỉ ra: 'They're not in either of those places, you know – you're wearing them!' (Cô đang đeo kính ngay trên mặt/đầu mình). Đáp án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: phòng khách, phòng sinh hoạt chung

questions.prompt: What damage was done to the car?

options.text: A broken window on the side
Long scratches on the door
Paint splashed all over the side

questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông hỏi có phải xe lại bị cào xước sơn không, người phụ nữ đáp: 'No, not scratches this time. Someone's put paint all over the side.' (Lần này không phải vết xước, mà ai đó đã bôi/tạt sơn khắp mặt hông xe). Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: What did she bring?

options.text: Soap, a towel, and a toothbrush
A towel, a toothbrush, and toothpaste
Soap, a towel, and toothpaste

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ kiểm tra túi đồ và liệt kê những thứ cô mang theo: 'Wait a minute, I'll look … soap, towel, toothbrush. Er … no, sorry, I forgot [the toothpaste].' Như vậy cô mang xà phòng, khăn tắm và bàn chải đánh răng (quên kem đánh răng). Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: What did Sally buy?

options.text: A skirt and a pair of shoes
A T-shirt and a skirt
A T-shirt and a pair of jeans

vocabularyNotes.meaning: rời khỏi, thoát khỏi nơi nào

questions.explanationVi: John nói trước đây cậu từng muốn làm cầu thủ bóng đá hoặc bác sĩ, và khi cô giáo gợi ý nghề kỹ sư, cậu trả lời: 'It's a nice idea – but I think I'd like to do what my dad does. He teaches maths.' (Em muốn làm nghề giống bố em — dạy môn Toán). Đáp án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. You will listen to six short conversations TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C) for questions 8 to 14.
tasks.transcript:
[Conversation 8 - Two friends talking about a new café in town]:
Man: I've just been into the shopping centre. There's a new cafe by the station.
Woman: Yes, I know. I went there last week. I think it opened some time ago actually.
Man: I only looked through the window. It looks really nice.
Woman: Yes, it's nice and bright and the staff are really helpful. It's simple fast food. People might just want to grab something to eat before they catch a train, so it should do well.
Man: OK, I'll go in and try it next time I'm in town.

[Conversation 9 - Two friends talking about litter]:
Man: Have you seen all that litter blowing around in the street outside?
Woman: I know. It looks awful, doesn't it?
Man: I don't know what we pay our taxes for. Why aren't the street cleaners out there tidying up?
Woman: I know, but people don't seem to think about dropping litter. We shouldn't expect there to be a street cleaner running around behind everyone tidying up their rubbish.
Man: Yes, I suppose you're right. But it does look so messy and someone needs to keep the streets clean.

[Conversation 10 - A woman telling a friend about a new car]:
Man: Well done! I hear you've passed your driving test. Congratulations!
Woman: Yes, I'm thinking about buying myself a nice little car now.
Man: Really? What kind are you looking for?
Woman: Nothing too expensive, that's for sure. A small one to drive around town. At first I wasn't sure I wanted to use it to go to the office, but I might car-share with a colleague to save on petrol.
Man: That's a good idea. Just make sure you find someone you like to talk to in the morning!

[Conversation 11 - Two friends talking about a website they use]:
Man: You travel a lot by train, don't you? Do you book your tickets online?
Woman: Yes, I use Train Track. It's my favourite site when I need to book anything.
Man: Yes, me too. Some sites make it difficult to choose times and dates but that's never a problem on that site.
Woman: I know. But have you noticed that sometimes the price of tickets goes up if you don't order straightaway? If you search the same journey later, it's more expensive.
Man: Yes, I've noticed that too.

[Conversation 12 - Two friends talking about a photography competition]:
Woman: I heard about your brother winning that photography competition - that was very good.
Man: I know. His photos are amazing.
Woman: What kind of photos does he take?
Man: The prize was for his photos of strangers in the street.
Woman: Are people happy for him to take their photo?
Man: He takes it first and then shows it to them on his camera. He always tells them what it's for and unless they ask him to delete it, he uses it. He says that people rarely complain. Some of them ask him to email them a copy.

[Conversation 13 - Two friends talking about the man's birthday]:
Woman: Happy birthday, Michael. Have you had a nice day?
Man: Yes, it's been wonderful. Everyone has been so kind.
Woman: Did the kids get you anything nice?
Man: My daughter got up early and made me breakfast in bed. Toast and a cup of coffee.
Woman: That must have been lovely.
Man: It was. I'm certainly not used to that. My son was supposed to help but he forgot and woke up late. But he heard us laughing and joking and joined us when I was opening my presents.

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about a new cafe in town. What does the woman say about it?

options.text: It has just opened.
The choice of food is too simple.
She thinks it will be successful.

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ nhận xét về quán cà phê cạnh nhà ga: 'People might just want to grab something to eat before they catch a train, so it should do well.' ('it should do well' = cô ấy nghĩ quán sẽ kinh doanh thành công). Phương án A sai vì quán đã mở cách đây một thời gian ('opened some time ago'). Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: nhân viên quét dọn đường phố

(Lúc đầu cô chưa chắc có muốn lái xe tới văn phòng không, nhưng giờ cô dự định lái xe đi làm chung với một đồng nghiệp để tiết kiệm tiền xăng). Đáp án C đúng.

Như vậy cả hai cùng cho rằng đặt vé ngay lập tức sẽ rẻ hơn ('cheaper if you book immediately'). Đáp án B đúng.

He always tells them what it's for and unless they ask him to delete it, he uses it.' Anh ấy luôn cho họ xem ảnh và xin phép trước khi sử dụng bức ảnh đó. Đáp án A đúng.

Toast and a cup of coffee.' (Con gái tôi đã dậy sớm và làm bữa sáng gồm bánh mì nướng và cà phê mang tận giường cho tôi). Đáp án A đúng.

tasks.title: Part 3: Longer Conversation
tasks.instructions: There are 6 questions in this part. You will listen to a conversation between a man and a woman at home TWICE. For questions 15 to 20, decide whether each statement is Correct (True) or Incorrect (False). Choose A for True and B for False.
tasks.transcript:
Man: What shall we do tonight? Shall we go out somewhere?
Woman: No, I'm tired. I've had a really hard day.
Man: That's a bit boring! Come on, let's go to a cinema or see that new play at the theatre.
Woman: Not tonight. Why don't we rent a video and stay in?
Man: Well, I'd rather go out … but if you're tired … OK. So what shall we have? How about that new Italian film?
Woman: No, far too serious for me. I'd fall asleep! Why can't we get something funny – a film with Rik Moranis or someone like that.
Man: A comedy? No thanks. I'm not wasting my money.
Woman: Well, I'll pay, if you're going to be difficult about it.
Man: I'm not being difficult – I just don't want to see a comedy.
Woman: Fine. What else do you suggest then?
Man: How about a Robert de Niro?
Woman: We've seen them all.
Man: Maybe, but they're great films. Let's watch one again.
Woman: Now you're suggesting something that's a real waste of money! And I hate seeing films twice, you know that.
Man: OK, OK. What, then?
Woman: Oh, forget it. We're obviously not going to agree anyway!
Man: No, I tell you what, you go down to the video shop and choose a film. Whatever it is, I'll watch it.
Woman: Really? And you won't be difficult or make me feel guilty?
Man: No – go on, off you go. I'll make something to eat while you're out.
Woman: Great. See you in a few minutes then.
Man: Bye.

questions.prompt: The man wants to spend the evening at home.

options.text: Correct (True)
Incorrect (False)

questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông mở đầu bằng câu: 'Shall we go out somewhere?' và sau đó nài nỉ: 'Come on, let's go to a cinema or see that new play at the theatre... Well, I'd rather go out'. Như vậy anh ấy muốn đi ra ngoài chơi chứ không muốn ở nhà. Câu nhận định là SAI (False). Đáp án B.

questions.prompt: The woman suggests they hire a video.

options.text: Correct (True)
Incorrect (False)

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ đề xuất: 'Not tonight. Why don't we rent a video and stay in?' ('rent a video' đồng nghĩa với 'hire a video' — thuê băng đĩa phim về nhà xem). Câu nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

questions.prompt: They both want to see something light.

options.text: Correct (True)
Incorrect (False)

questions.explanationVi: Chỉ có người phụ nữ muốn xem phim hài nhẹ nhàng ('Why can't we get something funny'), còn người đàn ông phản đối kịch liệt: 'A comedy? No thanks. I'm not wasting my money... I just don't want to see a comedy.' Câu nhận định là SAI (False). Đáp án B.

questions.prompt: The woman only likes to see a film once.

options.text: Correct (True)
Incorrect (False)

questions.explanationVi: Khi người đàn ông gợi ý xem lại một bộ phim của Robert de Niro, người phụ nữ đáp: 'And I hate seeing films twice, you know that.' (Em ghét xem lại phim hai lần, anh biết rõ điều đó mà). Như vậy cô chỉ thích xem mỗi bộ phim một lần. Câu nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

questions.prompt: In the end they decide to watch a video.

options.text: Correct (True)
Incorrect (False)

questions.explanationVi: Cuối cùng người đàn ông nhường vợ: 'you go down to the video shop and choose a film. Whatever it is, I'll watch it.' Và người phụ nữ vui vẻ đi thuê băng video. Câu nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: cảm thấy áy náy, có lỗi

questions.prompt: The man offers to prepare some food.

options.text: Correct (True)
Incorrect (False)

questions.explanationVi: Trước khi người phụ nữ ra tiệm thuê băng đĩa, người đàn ông nói: 'No – go on, off you go. I'll make something to eat while you're out.' (Anh sẽ làm chút đồ ăn trong lúc em ra ngoài). Câu nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

tasks.title: Task 1: New Company Fitness Center Announcement
tasks.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words for your company's internal noticeboard announcing the opening of the new staff fitness center. Use all the information in the box.

writingPrompts.title: New Staff Fitness Center Notice
writingPrompts.instructions: Write at least 80 words informing all employees about the new fitness center. Include all details from the card.

dataCard.Location & Opening Date: 3rd Floor, Building B — Opens Monday, November 2nd
dataCard.Facilities & Classes: Modern gym equipment, yoga studio, and free evening aerobics classes
dataCard.Registration: Free for all full-time staff; Register online with HR by October 28th

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: We are pleased to announce the opening of the new Apex Company Fitness and Wellness Center for all employees. The center is located on the third floor of Building B and will officially open on Monday, November 2nd. It will be open from 6:30 a.m. to 8:30 p.m., Monday through Saturday. Employees can enjoy modern gym equipment, a quiet yoga studio, and free aerobics classes every evening after work. Membership is completely free for all full-time staff members. To get your access card, please register online with the HR department before October 28th. We look forward to seeing you there!

tasks.title: Task 2: Opinion / Solutions Paragraph (Choice)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two topics below and write a paragraph of at least 100 words. State your main point clearly and provide supporting reasons and examples.

writingPrompts.title: Choose Topic 2.1 or Topic 2.2
writingPrompts.instructions: Choose ONE topic and write a well-structured paragraph of at least 100 words.

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about the benefits of learning a foreign language for university students.
guidelines: Better career opportunities in international companies
Making friends and understanding different cultures when travelling
Accessing global books, courses, and study materials online

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about practical ways individuals can reduce plastic waste in daily life.
guidelines: Bringing reusable cloth bags when shopping at supermarkets
Using personal water bottles and coffee cups instead of single-use plastic
Choosing products with paper or glass packaging

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Learning a foreign language brings many valuable benefits to university students in today's modern world. Firstly, speaking a second language such as English or Japanese opens the door to better job opportunities. Many international companies offer high salaries to graduates who can communicate confidently with foreign clients. Secondly, knowing another language helps students access a huge amount of information on the internet, including academic books, international news, and online courses. Finally, it makes travelling abroad much more enjoyable because students can talk to local people and understand new cultures directly. In conclusion, mastering a foreign language is a useful skill for both future careers and personal growth.

tasks.instructions: In this part, you will answer 5 questions about yourself and familiar everyday topics. Give clear, natural answers of 2 to 3 sentences each.

speakingPrompts.title: Social Interaction — End-Course Test 1
questions: Which do you prefer, Saturday or Sunday?
Do you have any hobbies or interests?

What are the advantages of regular exercise?

tasks.title: Part 2: Cue-based Description (5 minutes)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two given cards. You have 1 minute to prepare and 2 minutes to speak, followed by two follow-up questions.

speakingPrompts.title: Cue Cards — End-Course Test 1
speakingPrompts.instructions: Choose Card 1 or Card 2 and talk for 1.5 to 2 minutes.

cueCards.title: Describe a library that you often go to.
prompts: where it is / what the library looks like
and explain why you like this library.
furtherQuestions: What kind of people go to libraries most often?
Why do you think a library is a good place for reading?
cueCards.sampleResponse: I would like to talk about my university central library, which I visit three times a week. It is a modern five-storey building located right in the middle of our campus, surrounded by green trees. Inside, it is bright, quiet, and equipped with comfortable wooden desks and fast Wi-Fi. Whenever I go there, I borrow English reference books, review my lecture notes, and complete group assignments in the discussion rooms. I really love this library because its peaceful atmosphere helps me concentrate much better than studying in my noisy dormitory.

cueCards.title: Describe an outdoor activity that you like doing.
prompts: and explain why you like it.
furtherQuestions: What are the most popular outdoor activities in Viet Nam?
Do old and young people like doing the same kinds of activities outdoors?
cueCards.sampleResponse: An outdoor activity that I really enjoy doing is jogging in the park. I usually go jogging for thirty minutes every morning before breakfast, and on weekends I spend an hour running with my best friend. We always run around Cau Giay Park near my house because the air is fresh and there are many shady trees along the lake. I love this activity because it costs nothing, keeps my body healthy and fit, and helps me clear my mind before starting a busy day of study.
